2. **Restart dsh** (profiles load at startup);
3. Tell dsh "check the browse"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"r environment" — the model runs `wc3_doctor` and reports what's missing."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Re-running the installer updates the plugin."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Tool | relay op | Purpose |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `wc3_doctor` | - | Channel self-check (Node/engine/relay/extension); auto-starts the relay |
| `wc"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"3_tabs` | `tab.list` | List tabs and get tabIds; `[当前]`=active tab, `[默认]`=wc3's default target |
| "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"`wc3_tab_open` | `tab.create` | Open a URL in a background tab (doesn't steal focus); becomes the ne"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"w default |
| `wc3_tab_close` | `tab.close` | Close a tab you opened; clears the default target if i"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"t was closed |
| `wc3_tab_activate` | `tab.list` + local state | Pin a tab as the default operation "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"target (no more "current tab" drift) |

| `wc3_get_text` | `page.getText` | Full-page plain text for reconna"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"issance |
| `wc3_eval` | `page.eval` | Run arbitrary JS in the page; preferred for structured extrac"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"tion |
| `wc3_click` / `wc3_fill` / `wc3_scroll_to` | `page.click` / `page.fillForm` / `page.scrollT"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"o` | Interact by `ref_N` (React/Vue-safe) |

| `maxResultChars` | `50000` | Max chars per result |
